title: A path-following framework on fiber bundle for variational inequalities
summary: This paper proposes a path-following framework for finite-dimensional variational inequalities with arbitrary continuous functions and compact convex domains. The approach first approximately reduces a general variational inequality to a smooth variational inequality on a simplex. Its key innovation is to formulate the smooth variational inequality on a simplex on a fiber bundle called the fixed-point bundle. Exploiting this geometric structure, the framework systematically integrates starting point selection, path-following, and singularity avoidance. Without any monotonicity or similar…
